challenges.title: Plot with Labels
challenges.exercise: Plot x=[1,2,3], y=[4,5,6]. Set xlabel to 'X Axis' and ylabel to 'Y Axis'. Print 'Labeled'.
challenges.solution:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.plot([1,2,3], [4,5,6])
plt.xlabel("X Axis")
plt.ylabel("Y Axis")
print("Labeled")
